summary: POSCO HOLDINGS INC. filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026, reporting its Q1 2026 provisional consolidated earnings under K-IFRS. Revenue was KRW 17.88 trillion, operating profit KRW 0.71 trillion, and profit attributable to owners KRW 0.47 trillion, with improvements over prior periods. Separately, the filing announces a joint venture agreement signed with JSW to build an integrated steel mill in India, under 50:50 ownership with an alternating CEO structure. This is a routine earnings release and a strategic joint venture, not a special situation event requiring categorization under special-situations categories.
